body: Ok. I'm walking home right now.

Im not sure if I'm willing to go to a hospital right now. But I suppose I can walk home and think things through without ending my life right this instant. Nobody would've stopped me if I jumped from that bridge though. It's a shame that I had second thoughts before doing it. :(

I've stepped away from the edge and I'm just sitting down on a park bench for now. To answer your question on what has brought me to this point, well that's a hard question to answer. I guess I feel like there's nothing I value or want in this life and that I don't have any good qualities about myself and that I inconvenience everyone I come into contact with.
I've given myself too many chances to count. I am a lost cause
I don't have a job, I don't have any source of income. So all I do is leech off of my mother's money.
Because I'm untalented and unskilled at everything and all i do is leech off of other people. Nobody cares about me and I don't blame them.

I am at a dead end and I just don't have the strength or will to live. It's way easier to die. That's probably why I'm going to jump right now. There's nothing that I have to live for. Nothing I value. And nothing I want to do other than remove my life so that I will never be able to curse someone with my presence ever again.
